| # CAN Wakeup/Wakeup by Pattern (WUP) {#can-wakeupwakeup-by-pattern-wup-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                               |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Wakeup by Pattern (WUP) is a mechanism to wake up the ECU with the help of a CAN frame received via CAN channels which support wakeup mechanism, independent of frame related parameters.

It is supported on CAN1 and CAN4.

## Prerequisites for WUP to happen: {#prerequisites-for-wup-to-happen .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Wakeup by Pattern is configured in easyConfig (refer [Parameter configuration in eC (CAN wakeup)](configuration-parameters-required-for-wakeup-by-can.html){.topiclink}).

- T15 should be OFF.

Wakeup source related information can be found out using BSW API  bds_sys_getResetInfo.
